_comment: Private profile of the upstream watch (P62), kept outside Git (/etc/upstream-watch/profile.json). versions: the components that are not in this repository, as installed on the servers (sample values here). exposure: override the catalog's exposure per component (public, tailnet, internal, build). ignore: the false-positive list; an entry matches a finding id from a digest or an advisory id (GHSA, CVE, OSV), with the reason. No secrets: the optional GitHub token is a separate root-only file.

ignore.reason: Ubuntu maintains its 6.8 kernel for 24.04 LTS beyond the upstream line
